trigger: CODEQL_RAM/CODEQL_THREADS set in a runner service or .env environment (not in repo)
summary: init exports CODEQL_RAM/THREADS from the env first, so a pre-set variable silently overrides the new inputs and the cap is not in force while the step stays green. No such variable exists in the repo (grep of deploy/ and scripts/ci). Close by checking the --ram=/--threads= values on the first main dispatch log (CH-1/CH-3). Derivation note: unhappy-path recorded impact I3 (the intended cap silently not in force, step green) and band MEDIUM; the linter derives HIGH from I3+E4. Recorded at the facts' band as a MANDATORY INVESTIGATION (speculative), not relabelled; the owner may rule that I5 (recurrence of the OOM class) is the true impact, which would derive MEDIUM.
classification_rationale: runner-level env is not visible to the repo
